response_contract.gain_cap_rationale: The 4.0 gain (12.04 dB) is a deliberately loose feasibility hypothesis, not a measured or identified hull RAO. It is used only to make the finite-band response-moment coefficient explicit; the SEA3-to-P2 inclusion certificate is required to be independent of this numerical gain. Replace this cap with a repository-owned vessel/IMU response model or accepted deployment hypothesis before physical SEA0 promotion.
